title: Main Menu
notes: Classic Path of Exile 1 menu theme, as requested; not the later Fall of Oriath theme or Path of Exile 2.
Unmodified MP3 from a community archive of the official soundtrack downloads. Embedded tags identify Main Menu, Adgio Hutchings, Path of Exile Soundtrack, 2013.
The original GGG sample link is now unavailable. The reference page preserves that link and identifies the menu music.
Bundled locally. Playback loops across the title screen and game, starts after interaction when the browser permits, and follows the existing Music slider and master mute.

Composer attribution is verified. Current ownership of the composition and recording, and permission to reuse this track in a fan game, have not been verified. GGG publishing the soundtrack does not by itself establish ownership.
